questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter the road from the wrong direction. You must stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are approaching a road with two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you the shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the upcoming bridge may be too narrow for you to pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. This lane cannot be used for passing or for driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey these signs. Where this sign is posted, passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange highway construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you the right lane ahead will be closed due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that loose gravel covers the road. Drive carefully because loose gravel reduces your tires' grip on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what traffic rules they must follow. This sign means large trucks are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians cross in this area. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to prevent brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones, which are dangerous for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you that traffic violations in work zones carry higher penalties.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what traffic rules they must follow. This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are driving the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the minimum legal speed. You must not drive slower than the speed posted on this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It alerts you that the road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Slow down and drive carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you a fire station is nearby. Be alert for emergency vehicles entering or leaving the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you an extra lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to be careful when the road is wet, as it becomes slippery and harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you of work ahead. Slow down and drive with extra caution through the work zone.
